name: Run the test suite before merging
description: Run the full test suite and confirm it passes before merging any pull request.
applies_when: reviewing a pull request before merge
does_not_apply_when: drafting a pull request that is not yet ready to merge
instructions: Run the full test suite and confirm it passes before merging.
If the tests cannot be run, say so and do not merge.
Treat a green test run as a merge precondition, not an optional step.
anti_patterns: Merging a pull request based on its title or description alone.
Assuming a dependency bump is safe without running the tests.
